headlines.title: " 실거주 예외 최장 3년 …민의 반영해 보완검토"
headlines.summary: 구윤철 부총리 밝혀 정부가 장기거주소득공제를 도입하는 가운데 비거주 1주택자의 실거주 예외 인정과 관련한 제도를 재검토할 계획이다. 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관(사진)은 7일 MBC 라디오 인터뷰에서 "국회 논의 단계 등을 통해 국민 의견을 충분히 경청하겠다"며 "합리적인 범위 내에서는 얼마든지 의견을 반영할 것"이라고 밝혔다.

headlines.title: “ 비거주 1주택 예외인정 , 3년 보다 더 늘릴 수도”
headlines.summary: ■ 구윤철, 실거주 규제 완화 시사 “국민 의견 듣고 신축적으로 검토” 같은 시군 내 이동 인정 여부 관건 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 지난 6일 오전 서울 종로구 정부서울청사에서 열린 비상경제본부 회의 겸 경제ㆍ구조혁신 관계장관회의에서 발언하고 있다.

headlines.title: 강남 16억 낮춘 급매 … 한강벨트는 올라
headlines.summary: 부동산 세제개편發 시장재편 "세금 오르기 전 빨리 팔자" 초고가 아파트 등 매물 늘어 마용성 아파트 가격 방어…李, 공급대책 최종점검 나서 정부가 8·3 세제개편안을 발표한 이후 서울 강남 초고가 단지에서 호가를 크게 낮춘 급매물이 나오기 시작했다. 실거주를 하더라도 보유세·양도세 부담이 커진 초고가 주택 소유자들이 절세를 위해 매도에 나선 것이다.

headlines.title: '공급 속도전' 위해 부동산 금융 규제 푼다
headlines.summary: 李 "주택공급 과감히 실천하라" 6시간 난상 토론 PF보증 확대 등 금융 지원 논의 이주비 대출규제 완화도 추진 "용산 부지, 서울시와 협의하라" 한성숙·구윤철·김용범 등 참석 이재명 대통령은 7일 '제3기 진실·화해를 위한 과거사정리위원회' 출범을 계기로 국가 폭력 피해자들을 청와대에 초청해 위로 오찬을 했다. 이 대통령이 인사말을 하고 있다.

headlines.title: 토허구역 실수요자 대출 규제 완화 검토
headlines.summary: 청년·신혼부부·갈아타기 등 대상 매수 자금 문턱 낮추는 핀셋 지원 연합뉴스 정부가 토지거래허가구역 안에서 무주택 청년과 신혼부부 등 실수요자를 대상으로 대출 규제를 일부 완화하는 방안을 검토하고 있다. 토허구역과 대출 규제가 겹치면서 투기 수요자뿐 아니라 실수요자도 자금 조달에 어려움을 겪는 부작용을 줄이려는 취지다.

headlines.title: 누가 웃고 누가 더 낼까… 세제 개편, 달라진 부동산 셈법
headlines.summary: [부동산 세제개편, 시장은 어디로]② 같은 30억원 집도 실거주·비거주·다주택 따라 세금 '천차만별' 같은 집값도 다른 세금…실거주 여부가 희비 갈랐다 서울 남산에서 바라본 서울시내 아파트 모습. [사진 연합뉴스] [이코노미스트 이승훈 기자] 서울에서 시가 20억원대 아파트에 10년째 살고 있는 A씨와 시가 50억원대 아파트를 보유한 B씨.

headlines.title: 구윤철 "30억 이하 1 주택 세부담 경감…상위 1%만 과세 정상화"

headlines.title: 美 “ 폴리실리콘 쓴 제품 15% 관세 ” 中저가공세 차단

top5_headlines.title: 美, 반도체· 태양 광패널 원료에 15 % 관세 만지작… 韓기업들 긴장
top5_headlines.summary: 중국산 폴리실리콘 제재 목적 무역확장법 조사 결과 공개 임박 美서 제품 만드는 기업 영향 주목 韓정부 "유연 적용해달라" 요청 【파이낸셜뉴스 서울·뉴욕=박종원 기자 이병철 특파원】 지난해부터 중국을 겨냥해 폴리실리콘 추가 관세를 추진했던 미국 도널드 트럼프 정부가 이르면 6일(현지시간) 결과를 발표할 예정이다.

top5_headlines.title: '공급 속도전' 위해 부동산 금융 규제 푼다
top5_headlines.summary: 李 "주택공급 과감히 실천하라" 6시간 난상 토론 PF보증 확대 등 금융 지원 논의 이주비 대출규제 완화도 추진 "용산 부지, 서울시와 협의하라" 한성숙·구윤철·김용범 등 참석 이재명 대통령은 7일 '제3기 진실·화해를 위한 과거사정리위원회' 출범을 계기로 국가 폭력 피해자들을 청와대에 초청해 위로 오찬을 했다. 이 대통령이 인사말을 하고 있다.

top5_headlines.title: 누가 웃고 누가 더 낼까… 세제 개편, 달라진 부동산 셈법

top5_headlines.title: “ 비거주 1주택 예외인정 , 3년 보다 더 늘릴 수도”
top5_headlines.summary: ■ 구윤철, 실거주 규제 완화 시사 “국민 의견 듣고 신축적으로 검토” 같은 시군 내 이동 인정 여부 관건 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 지난 6일 오전 서울 종로구 정부서울청사에서 열린 비상경제본부 회의 겸 경제ㆍ구조혁신 관계장관회의에서 발언하고 있다.

top5_headlines.title: 美 “ 폴리실리콘 쓴 제품 15% 관세 ” 中저가공세 차단
top5_headlines.summary: 미국내 태양광 생산거점 확대 노려 韓 한화-OCI 등 반사이익 가능성 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령. 워싱턴=AP/뉴시스 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 6일(현지 시간) 반도체와 태양광의 핵심 재료인 웨이퍼 등 폴리실리콘 파생제품에 15% 관세를 부과한다는 포고령을 발표했다. 중국의 저가 공세를 막고 미국 내 태양광 생산 거점을 확대하기 위한 조치다.

key_headlines.title: US Imposes 15% Tariff on Polysilicon Products, Targeting Chinese Competition
key_headlines.summary: The Trump administration announced a 15% tariff on polysilicon-derived products including semiconductor wafers and solar panels to block Chinese low-cost competition and expand US domestic production. Korean companies like Hanwha and OCI may benefit from this policy shift.

key_headlines.title: South Korea Relaxes Real Estate Finance Regulations to Accelerate Housing Supply
key_headlines.summary: President Lee Jae-myung directed the government to ease property finance restrictions and expand PF guarantees to accelerate housing construction. The administration is also considering relaxing relocation loan regulations and discussing redevelopment and reconstruction initiatives.

key_headlines.title: Tax System Overhaul Creates Vastly Different Tax Burdens for Same-Value Properties
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's 2026 tax reform targets ultra-luxury homes and non-resident single-property owners, resulting in dramatically different tax obligations for identically-priced properties depending on occupancy status and ownership type.

key_headlines.title: Korean Battery Makers Pivot to Robot Batteries as Next Growth Engine
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's three battery manufacturers, having exited losses, are targeting robot batteries as their next growth driver, leveraging solid-state battery technology. Robots present a lower-cost opportunity than electric vehicles to commercialize advanced battery technology.

key_headlines.title: US Employment Shock Triggers Bond Yield Decline and Stock Market Surge
key_headlines.summary: Weaker-than-expected US employment data reversed market sentiment, pushing Treasury yields lower and stock markets higher despite previous hawkish Federal Reserve signals. September interest rate decision probability remains uncertain between hold and hike scenarios.

sections.Hot Economy News: The Trump administration's 15% tariff on polysilicon products marks a significant shift in US trade policy aimed at containing Chinese competition in semiconductors and solar panels. Simultaneously, South Korea is aggressively relaxing real estate finance restrictions and exploring tax reforms to accelerate housing supply, with President Lee directing flexible application of regulations. The government's comprehensive approach includes expanding project finance guarantees, easing relocation loan restrictions, and evaluating redevelopment and reconstruction opportunities. These dual developments reflect competing priorities between protectionist trade measures and domestic supply-side economic stimulus. Market participants are closely monitoring how these policies interact with global economic indicators.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: China's July producer prices rose 3.5% and consumer prices increased 0.5%, continuing upward trends influenced by Middle East tensions and energy uncertainties. South Korea's current account surplus is expected to approach 15% of GDP this year, rivaling global leaders like Ireland and Norway, signaling strong external economic performance. However, Gyeonggi Province faces a 21% budget shortfall in basic and opportunity income programs due to declining acquisition tax revenue from real estate downturn, highlighting regional fiscal stress. International analysts are raising forecasts for South Korea's current account strength amid global economic recalibration. The week ahead brings critical US inflation data expected to shape central bank policy decisions.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI stabilized this week as foreign investor inflows remained modest despite Won-Dollar exchange rate improvements, indicating lingering concerns about inflation and interest rate trajectories. Bloomberg analysis suggests extreme market volatility may be entering a resolution phase as leveraged positions unwind and regulatory measures take effect, with the VKOSPI volatility index declining sharply from June highs. US employment data surprised markets negatively, triggering a bond yield selloff and equity market rally, shifting expectations away from September rate hikes. The Won-Dollar exchange rate and US inflation data are emerging as key variables determining foreign investor sentiment toward Korean equities. Technical indicators suggest Korean stocks may be undervalued after the volatility correction period.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's three battery manufacturers are aggressively pursuing robot batteries and solid-state battery commercialization as their next growth frontier following profitability recovery. The robot battery market presents lower price sensitivity than electric vehicles, where battery costs represent 40% versus only 2% of robot costs, reducing consumer resistance to premium technologies. The government's announced robot industry initiative, including Samsung's new RX business division, signals comprehensive support for this emerging sector. Solid-state battery technology promises enhanced safety and capacity but faces challenges in cost efficiency and mass production scalability. Industry expectations for rapid robot market expansion are driving investment acceleration across Korea's battery sector.
sections.Real Estate: Government tax reforms targeting ultra-luxury properties and non-resident single-property owners are expected to redirect capital flows from high-end segments toward mid-tier properties, reshaping investment patterns. The administration is evaluating redevelopment and reconstruction initiatives as components of its housing supply acceleration strategy, with potential regulatory easing under consideration. Purchase mortgage restrictions remain in effect, yet ultra-premium properties continue transacting as buyers with alternative financing capabilities dominate that market segment. The government is exploring office-to-residential conversions and expanded public supply mechanisms to increase non-apartment housing inventory. Gyeonggi Province's fiscal constraints are limiting affordable housing program funding, highlighting regional supply-side challenges.
sections.International Economy: President Trump's tariff policies, despite reaching 57.6% disapproval in South Korean surveys, have not fundamentally altered Seoul's defense spending commitments, with the government agreeing to increase defense expenditure to 3.5% of GDP. The Trump administration is renewing efforts to remove Federal Reserve Board member Cook, citing mortgage fraud allegations, reflecting political pressure on monetary policy decisions. US President Trump is reportedly profiting from advance social media disclosures of policy announcements through selective information timing, creating market advantages for algorithmic traders. Hanwha Solutions' stock surged 30% following the US polysilicon tariff announcement, benefiting from China-targeting trade measures as a non-Chinese producer. Short-term missile supply constraints amid geopolitical tensions are adding complexity to inflation expectations and rate-setting dynamics.
sections.AI & Economy: MIT economist Erik Brynjolfsson, co-author of recent Nobel laureate economic statements on AI employment impacts, argues that AI should complement rather than replace human workers while emphasizing productivity acceleration potential. The productivity explosion from AI adoption is entering its early acceleration phase, though consumer benefits are not yet fully reflected in GDP measurements, suggesting future statistical revisions. Major construction companies are increasing data center investments to capture AI infrastructure demand, with semiconductor-related capacity expansions continuing through at least 2027. OpenAI has partially halted development of next-generation AI models pending safety verification, as concerns intensify about AI systems performing dangerous actions without human supervision. Organizations must comprehensively restructure themselves around AI capabilities to realize expected productivity multipliers.
sections.Others: SK Hynix is evaluating the sale of its approximately $3 billion Chongqing NAND flash packaging facility to reallocate capital toward high-bandwidth memory production and capacity expansion amid explosive AI demand. Savings bank deposit rates in the 4% range have essentially disappeared as market funds reverse direction from equities back toward financial institutions, reducing competitive rate pressures. Japan's sovereign debt burden remains highest among G7 nations at 214% of GDP, yet its interest rates stay lowest as the Bank of Japan continues extensive bond purchases, creating structural imbalances. Currency conversion timing for international travel depends on expected exchange rate movements, currently influenced by divergent monetary policy trajectories between central banks. Consumer sentiment regarding AI safety is emerging as an economic variable affecting investment flows and technology adoption rates.
